How it works

Each item stays saved in your menu library. The sidebar is grouped by the category you give each item, so it is quick to choose regulars for the week. Removing an item deletes it permanently; turning it off only hides it from this week’s menu.

Use Chrome or Microsoft Edge for the folder-selection button.
